signatures.description: Build a Node.js coordinator that reconciles conflicting updates from a quorum-replicated store when replicas have bounded but unknown clock skew, partial network partitions, and delayed acknowledgements. Define a deterministic conflict-resolution protocol that preserves causal order when evidence exists, avoids unsafe last-write-wins decisions when it does not, and remains safe across retries and coordinator failover; validate it with a fault-injection simulator.
